zooms.label: le tableau
zooms.hint: Look closer at the big painting in the gold frame

atelier_couleurs.alt: The ground-floor colour workshop, painted in ink and gouache: the arched wooden front door on the far left leads back out to the village square; shelves of paint pots hang on the walls and a balcony above has three doors, red, yellow and blue; a big gold-framed painting of a sunny courtyard hangs on the right. On a low stage a detective in a black coat and hat holds a closed umbrella by a black-and-white striped easel, a young painter in a white smock points his brush at a blank white canvas, and a clown in a red suit touches his rosy cheek. In front, a girl in sunglasses holds up a rainbow colour wheel, a boy blows up a blue balloon and a green frog sits on a dripping tin of green paint.

tableau.name: Le tableau de la cour
tableau.alt: A close look at the gold-framed painting: a sunny village courtyard with a fountain, where a grey elephant peeks out of a sack of peanuts, a pink flamingo stands beside a pot of pink roses, two wooden mannequins compare a deep blue card and a pale blue card, a boy in yellow overalls rolls a yellow patch onto the paving and a brown teddy bear holds a plate with a chocolate bun.

formes.name: Le grenier des formes

doors.label: l'atelier
doors.hint: Back through the green door to the workshop

zooms.label: le tableau
zooms.hint: Look closer at the painting of the meadow

formes.alt: The attic of shapes, painted in ink and gouache: a green arched door on the left leads back down to the workshop and a framed painting of a meadow hangs on the wall. A big glossy blue glass ball, a perfect sphere, hangs on a string from the attic beam. A girl pats a heap of white foam into shapes, a girl in a yellow dress leans as she walks beside a long purple line on the floorboards, a ballerina balances on the tip of one pointe shoe on a paint tin, a giant wooden chess pawn stands on a big black dot, a bored boy perches on the edge of a stool with his chin in his hand, and a puppy sits on a big gold coin in the corner.

toile.name: Le tableau du pré
toile.alt: A close look at the meadow painting: a girl leans over a wide stone basin and sees her face on the still water, a white canvas on an easel carries one bold black brushstroke, a boy kneels to draw a heart in a bowl of sand with a stick, and an orange hoop leans against a tree stump.

mesures.name: La salle des mesures

doors.label: l'atelier
doors.hint: Back through the blue door to the workshop

zooms.label: le tableau
zooms.hint: Look closer at the painting of the harbour

mesures.alt: The measuring room, painted in ink and gouache: a blue door on the far left leads back to the workshop and a framed painting of a harbour hangs on the wall. A little girl gapes up at a potted sunflower much taller than her, a little boy dressed as a circus strongman in red hoists two iron weights, a chimp in a red bow tie hugs a very thick book, a boy marches over evenly spaced footprints, a stooping giant lets a blue jay perch on his thumb and a huge wooden barrel lies heaped with bread and apples.

port.name: Le tableau du port
port.alt: A close look at the harbour painting: a girl shows off two crisp framed lion portraits, a square red toy car glows in a ray of sunshine, Santa kneels to measure along a long yellow ruler, a boy lays a stick straight across a cartwheel, another boy pours white sand around a chalk circle, and a hen on a green hexagon stares at her empty nest.

teintures.name: L'atelier des teintures

doors.label: l'atelier
doors.hint: Back through the yellow door to the workshop

zooms.label: le tableau
zooms.hint: Look closer at the painting of the lilac meadow

teintures.alt: The dye workshop, painted in ink and gouache: a yellow arched door on the far left leads back to the workshop and a framed painting of a lilac meadow hangs high on the right. A laundress holds up a shirt with a moustache-shaped stain, a young man lifts a tent dyed blue at the bottom out of a vat, a boy in a violet suit plays a purple violin, a black cone and a white cone are tied together on a stool, a painter in blue mixes shades on her palette, a snail glides over a copper pot of greenery, a beige newt sits on a bench between a red dye tub and a blue dye tub, and an old seamstress pins a royal purple gown onto a mannequin.

pre.name: Le tableau des lilas
pre.alt: A close look at the lilac meadow painting: a dazzling white sheet hangs on a line over a steaming tub, a crate overflows with bananas, grapes, apples and oranges, a young jeweller with a magnifier lays a row of green emeralds on green velvet, a pile of many blue tins stands in the grass, a boy pushes a cart of brown chestnuts, a patchwork kitten sits by the paint pots and a girl sings to a big lilac bush in bloom.
